title: Settings > General Settings > Social Media Tab

sections.heading: Social Media Account Links
sections.content:
Configure links to your company social profiles that appear in the website header, footer, and email notifications.
Supported platforms: Facebook, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, Pinterest, TikTok, WhatsApp, and RSS Feed.

sections.heading: How to Configure
sections.content:
1. Go to Settings > General Settings.
2. Click on the 'Social Media' tab.
3. Paste the full URLs for each respective profile (e.g. https://facebook.com/yourpage).
4. Click 'Save Changes'. The icons will immediately update across your live site.
